summary: Range-check --min-pass-rate, and declare rollout's reachable exit 3.
reason: gate --min-pass-rate takes a fraction, but people think in percentages: --min-pass-rate 90 is silently unsatisfiable, so every candidate 'regresses' against a floor of 9000% and CI blocks forever on a typo that reads as a reasonable threshold. It is now a usage error. Separately, rollout declared pp:typed-exit-codes 0,2 while the unknown-task guard added by rightbrain-unknown-task-exit-codes returns 3; the annotation feeds the MCP tool manifest, so an agent branching on declared codes could not know 3 was reachable. The help text now also carries the eval-run caveat that was documented only outside the CLI.
validated_outcome: rollout --help reports exit 3 and the eval-run caveat; gate --min-pass-rate 90 exits 2 with a message naming the fraction form.
